{{Short description|Norwegian mathematician (1937–2023)}}
'''Kristian Barstad Dysthe''' (16 September 1937 – 30 July 2023) was a Norwegian mathematician.

==Biography==
Dysthe took the [[cand.real.]] degree at the [[University of Bergen]] in 1962, and the [[dr.philos.]] degree in 1972. He became professor in [[applied mathematics]] at the [[University of Tromsø]] in 1972, and at the University of Bergen from 1992 to retirement in 2007. He has been a visiting scholar at the [[University of Cambridge]], the [[Scripps Institution of Oceanography]] and the [[Stanford University]].<ref>{{cite news|title=70 år 16. september: Professor, dr.philos. Kristian Barstad Dysthe|last=Norwegian News Agency|date=7 September 2007|language=Norwegian}}</ref> He was a member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27624|title=Gruppe 1: Matematiske fag|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=28 October 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110927170150/http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27624|archive-date=27 September 2011|url-status=dead}}</ref> Dysthe died on 30 July 2023, at the age of 85.<ref>{{cite web |title=Kristian Barstad Dysthe |url=https://www.vg.no/minnesider/kristian-barstad-dysthe |website=VG |access-date=10 September 2023}}</ref>
